item.title: SONDEO Banco Central de Colombia mantendría estable su tasa por terremoto pese a inflación alta
item.description: El Banco Central de Colombia mantendría inalterada su tasa de interés en la reunión de septiembre, a la espera de la evolución de la economía tras el terremoto que azotó al país en agosto, a pesar de las persistentes presiones inflacionarias, reveló el viernes un sondeo de Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Nelson Bocanegra
item.content:encoded: El Banco Central de Colombia mantendría inalterada su tasa de interés en la reunión de septiembre, a la espera de la evolución de la economía tras el terremoto que azotó al país en agosto, a pesar de las persistentes presiones inflacionarias, reveló el viernes un sondeo de Reuters. En la consulta, 19 de los 27 analistas proyectaron estabilidad del tipo referencial en el actual 12% en la reunión del próximo miércoles, seis estimaron un alza de 50 puntos base a 12,50% y los dos restantes pronosticaron un incremento de 25 puntos base a 12,25%. De cumplirse la postura mayoritaria se trataría de la segunda vez consecutiva en la que la autoridad monetaria mantiene sin cambios el costo referencial del dinero, después de los incrementos de enero, marzo y junio pasados, en los que acumuló un total de 275 puntos base. En agosto no hubo reunión de política monetaria. "Si bien la inflación se aceleró recientemente, hay varios factores que moderarían el tono de la junta del Banco de la República, entre ellos la apreciación de la tasa de cambio y las necesidades de reconstrucción en zonas afectadas por el terremoto", dijo el Banco de Occidente. Una amplia zona del suroeste y centro del país fue azotada el 10 de agosto por un fuerte terremoto que destruyó casas, edificios e infraestructura, cuya reconstrucción demandará al menos 30 billones de pesos, según estimaciones del Gobierno. "Los efectos del reciente terremoto favorecen una postura de estabilidad (de la tasa de interés) en el corto plazo, dado que el choque, además de generar presiones sobre algunos precios, afectó la actividad productiva", explicó Aval Asset Management. No obstante, una minoría considera que el Banco Central retomaría las alzas de la tasa de interés para contener las presiones inflacionarias, que podrían acentuarse en los próximos meses por el fenómeno climático de El Niño, que amenaza con incrementar los precios de los alimentos y de la energía. "La persistencia de las presiones de demanda e indexación y los elevados niveles de la inflación básica indican que es necesario un mayor endurecimiento monetario", opinó el holding de inversiones Corfi. Al cierre de agosto, Colombia acumuló una inflación anual de 6,24%, la más alta en dos años y superior a la meta a largo plazo del Banco Central, de 3%, que según los analistas se incumplirá por sexto año consecutivo en 2026 y también en 2027. La semana pasada, la codirectora del Banco Central, Olga Lucía Acosta, dijo a Reuters que el repunte de la inflación exige una revisión de las presiones sobre los precios para determinar qué tan contractiva debe ser la política monetaria, por lo que consideró que aún se debe actuar para encaminar el indicador hacia la meta. La reunión del banco central colombiano se realizará después de que este mes la Reserva Federal estadounidense subió en un cuarto de punto porcentual sus tasas de interés, mientras que el Reino Unido y México las mantuvieron estables y Brasil la redujo en 25 puntos base. En tanto, las expectativas de tasa de interés para fin del año pasaron a un 12,25% desde un 12,50% en el sondeo anterior, al tiempo que para el cierre de 2027 disminuyeron a un 11%, desde un 11,25% previo.

item.title: Poste falls short of Telecom Italia delisting threshold after takeover bid
item.description: Poste Italiane has secured 85.82% of Telecom Italia (TIM) after increasing the price of its takeover bid and reopening it, Reuters calculations based on stock exchange data showed on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Poste Italiane (PST.MI) has secured 85.82% of Telecom Italia (TIM) (TLIT.MI) after increasing the price of its takeover bid and reopening it, Reuters calculations based on stock exchange data showed on Friday. The take-up falls short of the 90% ownership threshold that would have allowed Poste to take TIM private, meaning the national post office would need to find other ways to delist it if they stick with their initial goal. Poste, which is controlled by the Italian state and operates mail, financial, energy and mobile services, last year became TIM's main shareholder, replacing France's Vivendi (VIV.PA) . In March it launched a €13 billion [USN:L6N40B0FE TEXT:"bid to take TIM private"] as part of a plan to create a national champion in digital infrastructure and services. It has forecast annual pre-tax benefits of €700 million from the deal. Poste had [USN:S8N43U02Z TEXT:"secured 66.6% of TIM"] during the main phase of its bid, which ended on September 11 - four days after [USN:L6N44Z0V2 TEXT:"a price increase"]. The offer reopened on Monday for a further five days.

item.title: 利回り上昇はインフレ懸念が要因でない＝米クリーブランド連銀総裁
item.description: [２５日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は２５日、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の２％目標を長年にわ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
利回り上昇はインフレ懸念が要因でない＝米クリーブランド連銀総裁 3:35 配信

2025年11月6日、米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁。 REUTERS/Brendan McDermid/File Photo

[２５日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は２５日、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の２％目標を長年にわたって上回っているインフレにより、物価上昇圧力が目標に戻るとの信認を失うのではないかとの懸念を強めていると述べた。一方で、国債利回りの急上昇はインフレ懸念が押し上げているのではないとの見方も示した。

ハマック氏はクリーブランド連銀主催のイベントで、インフレが５年超にわたって目標を上回っている状況を踏まえ「現時点でインフレに関して見られる最大のリスクは、インフレを前提とした思考様式が定着し始める可能性だ」と発言。ＦＲＢが果たすべき役割があるとし「物価を目標水準まで押し下げるため、金融政策が抑制的なスタンスにあることを確実にする必要がある」と述べた。

また、設備投資がしばらくインフレ圧力となり得るとしたほか、需要関連の物価上昇圧力にも警戒感を示した。

一方、急上昇している国債利回りについては、インフレ懸念によって押し上げられているわけではないとの見方を示した。国債利回りの急伸に関し「インフレ期待よりも実質金利がより大きく上昇した」と指摘した。その上で、米国の財政運営は持続不可能な軌道にあるとの見方も示した。

その上で「インフレ期待の観点からは、相応にしっかりとアンカー（安定）されている」と述べ、利回りの上昇は堅調な経済見通しや、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連分野への旺盛な投資に伴う投資資金の競合、市場参加者が金融政策の見通しに対応して価格を調整していることを反映しているとの認識を示した。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：米長期金利5％接近で株式市場に警戒感、決算後はマクロ要因に注目 焦点：ベセント氏発言で強まる日銀9月利上げ観測、米国の影響力拡大に懸念も アングル：米国債「ツイスト・スティープ化」、ＦＲＢの信認巡る懸念反映か アングル：インフレで揺らぐ債券のヘッジ機能、米投資家は実物資産に移行 最終更新: 9/26(土) 4:53 ロイター

item.title: Ações da Airbus caem após falha de qualidade no jato A321neo
item.description: As ações da Airbus caíram nesta sexta-feira, depois que a fabricante europeia reconheceu uma falha de qualidade na fuselagem de centenas de jatos A321neo, um dos modelos mais vendidos da empresa, reacendendo a pressão para que a fabricante cumpra o cronograma apertado de entregas este ano.
item.dc:creator: Tim Hepher, Giulia Segreti, Piotr Lipinski
item.content:encoded: As ações da Airbus (AIR.PA) caíram nesta sexta-feira, depois que a fabricante europeia reconheceu uma falha de qualidade na fuselagem de centenas de jatos A321neo, um dos modelos mais vendidos da empresa, reacendendo a pressão para que a fabricante cumpra o cronograma apertado de entregas este ano. O problema decorre da aplicação incorreta de uma camada de primer por um fornecedor italiano e, pela segunda vez em menos de um ano, coloca a Airbus diante de questionamentos sobre o controle de qualidade na maior parte de seu sistema fabril, disseram fontes da indústria. Confirmando o problema após a primeira reportagem do The Air Current, a Airbus afirmou que a segurança não foi afetada e reafirmou sua meta de entrega de cerca de 870 jatos para 2026, em comparação com os 475 entregues entre janeiro e agosto. "Nossa projeção para o ano todo foi formalmente divulgada durante a apresentação dos resultados do primeiro semestre, em 29 de julho – e essa continua sendo nossa posição pública atual", disse um porta-voz da Airbus. Uma solução foi identificada e as companhias aéreas continuam a receber as aeronaves afetadas, em alguns casos em troca de concessões relacionadas à manutenção futura, disseram fontes do setor. No entanto, alguns analistas disseram que o progresso das entregas da Airbus continuaria sendo o foco, enquanto a empresa trabalha para se recuperar dos atrasos anteriores. "Embora não esperemos que isso tenha um impacto significativo a longo prazo, poderá afetar a capacidade da Airbus de atingir sua meta de entrega de 870 este ano", escreveu o analista do Citi, Charles Armitage, acrescentando que isso dependerá da posição dos compradores e da extensão dos reparos. AÇÕES FICAM ATRÁS DE OUTROS PAPÉIS DE PRIMEIRA LINHA As ações da maior fabricante de aviões do mundo caíram cerca de 1,3%, ficando atrás de outras ações de primeira linha do índice CAC 40. A analista da Jefferies, Chloe Lemarie, afirmou que a disponibilidade de uma solução deve limitar qualquer impacto potencial nas entregas deste ano. A Airbus está empenhada em um esforço duplo para atingir um número recorde de entregas este ano, após prolongada pressão sobre as cadeias de suprimentos desde a pandemia de Covid-19, enquanto tenta alcançar uma taxa de produção repetidamente adiada de 75 aviões por mês, ante os cerca de 60 atuais. A Airbus afirmou que o problema envolvia um revestimento anticorrosivo defeituoso em componentes de reforço conhecidos como longarinas na fuselagem dianteira de um lote de jatos A321neo. Duas fontes da indústria disseram que o problema envolvia uma camada excessivamente fina de primer aplicada por uma subcontratada da italiana Leonardo ;, uma empresa privada chamada TESI, com sede em Cicerale, ao sul de Nápoles. A TESI não respondeu aos pedidos de comentários. A Leonardo confirmou que a TESI foi uma das várias fornecedoras para o seu trabalho no A321neo, mas recusou-se a dizer se a TESI realizou o trabalho neste caso específico. A Leonardo é uma das duas fornecedoras de longarinas para o A321neo, juntamente com a fabricante interna de aeroestruturas Airbus Atlantic, anteriormente conhecida como Stelia. A Airbus recusou-se a divulgar os nomes dos fornecedores, mas um porta-voz confirmou que o problema teve origem numa fonte de fornecimento externa. Em dezembro passado, a Airbus enfrentou problemas com painéis da fuselagem de um fornecedor espanhol. O problema foi considerado de qualidade, mas a investigação da situação causou meses de atrasos nas entregas e fez com que a Airbus não cumprisse sua meta inicial de entregas para 2025. A Airbus indicou que o problema mais recente é menos grave. O A321neo é o maior jato de corredor único da Airbus e tem superado em muito as vendas dos maiores modelos do seu rival, o 737 MAX da Boeing, ao mesmo tempo que deixa as fábricas europeias com um período de aumento de produção desafiador.

item.title: Nor'easter expected to disrupt travel, flood basements, knock out power along US East Coast
item.description: A strong nor'easter is expected to bring flooding, powerful wind gusts, heavy rain and rip currents to areas along the East Coast from Maine to Washington, D.C. over the weekend, and to affect flight schedules as world leaders leave New York City after the annual United Nations General Assembly session.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A strong nor'easter is expected to bring flooding, powerful wind gusts, heavy rain and rip currents to areas along the East Coast from Maine to Washington, D.C. over the weekend, and to affect flight schedules as world leaders leave New York City after the annual United Nations General Assembly session. The Federal Aviation Administration said on Friday that flights at all three major New York City area airports could be disrupted by strong winds. American Airlines (AAL.O) , JetBlue (JBLU.O) and United Airlines (UAL.O) waived change fees for eligible flights, encouraging customers to postpone travel between Friday and Sunday in the Northeast. The National Weather Service said winds of up to 55 miles per hour (88.5 km/h) in some areas could make driving difficult. New York City officials warned of possible basement flooding, power outages and travel disruptions. US passenger railroad Amtrak warned that service could be disrupted in the Northeast because of the storm. The open-air Global Citizen Festival in Manhattan's Central Park, scheduled for Sunday, and Ed Sheeran's concerts near Boston on Friday and Saturday, both expected to draw more than 50,000 attendees, were canceled. Major League Baseball rescheduled Sunday's game in Boston between the Chicago Cubs and Boston Red Sox for Friday, with the teams now playing a doubleheader at Fenway Park; the New York Yankees moved their Saturday home game against the Baltimore Orioles up to Friday afternoon. As the [USN:L8N45F07N TEXT:"UN General Assembly"] wraps up, among those scheduled to address the world body this weekend are China's vice president and the foreign ministers of Canada, Germany, India and Russia. "The UN has always endured, and surmounted, stormy weather both outside and inside the building," UN spokesperson Stephane Dujarric said when asked about the impending storm.

item.title: US immigration crackdown hits Kansas, disrupts beef processing
item.description: US immigration agents fanned out across southwest Kansas, home to a large concentration of feedlots and slaughterhouses, this week in an operation that had immediate effects on the beef industry, community organizers and local officials said.
item.dc:creator: Tom Polansek
item.content:encoded: US immigration agents fanned out across southwest Kansas , home to a large concentration of feedlots and slaughterhouses, this week in an operation that had immediate effects on the beef industry, community organizers and local officials said. The prospect of arrest kept much of the largely immigrant labor force away from work, forcing beef processing plants to slow down and backing up cattle, according to two community organizers and three groups representing livestock producers. "It's been chaotic," said Kathleen Alonso, a community volunteer from Liberal, Kansas. "Obviously they were stopping Brown people. They were not stopping any other races." As [USN:L6N45F193 TEXT:"affordability concerns weigh"] on the Republican Party's chances of maintaining control of the House and Senate in the upcoming US midterms, President Donald Trump has [USN:L6N44N16I TEXT:"enacted policies"] aimed at controlling the cost of beef. Immigration enforcement could be the latest to work at cross purposes, causing record-high beef prices to tick up even higher, according to industry and union officials. Cattle futures [USN:L1N45F0ZH TEXT:"gyrated"] this week as traders weighed tight US supplies against processing disruptions due to the crackdown. Local residents said they believed that dozens of people were detained, though the exact number was not immediately clear. The Department of Homeland Security, US Immigration and Customs Enforcement and the White House did not respond to requests for comment. ICE officers have stopped motorists this week to ask about their citizenship status around Dodge City, Liberal and Garden City, Kansas, small communities where most of the population is Latino, according to organizers and local government officials. Agents patrolled and parked in areas around meat plants and a large dairy, they said. The activity led to workforce disruptions at processors, feedlots and dairies, and delayed shipments of thousands of cattle, the Kansas Livestock Association, Oklahoma Cattlemen's Association and Texas Cattle Feeders Association said in a statement. "These ICE operations are having a massive chilling effect on the legal, documented, skilled workers that put beef on the table and keep the cattle supply chain moving," the groups said. "These types of disruptions will lead to higher beef prices for consumers." BEEF PRICES HAVE SOARED US beef prices soared to records this year after a multi-year drought drove ranchers to reduce their herds to a 75-year low and Washington [USN:L1N45A0X4 TEXT:"suspended cattle imports"] from Mexico . Trump has [USN:L6N3XS10B TEXT:"struggled"] to lower prices with a bevy of policies and other pronouncements, including increasing low-tariff beef imports and launching an investigation into meatpackers. Meatpackers slaughtered an estimated 90,000 cattle on Thursday, down 16% from a week earlier, the US Department of Agriculture said. Kansas ranks second nationwide for commercial cattle processing behind Nebraska , according to the agency. "A large percentage of milk and beef come from this region thanks to a lot of immigrants who work very hard to do jobs not many people do," Alonso said. "We are the heart of this country, and it is being terrorized, and we need it to stop." Two of the country's four large beef processors, National Beef Packing Company and Cargill, have plants in Dodge City. National Beef also has a plant in Liberal. Immigration agents focused their activity in areas around the plants on Wednesday, said Alejandro Rangel-Lopez, senior Latino and rural program manager for Kansas voting rights group Loud Light. "They tried really, really hard to get into National Beef in both Liberal and Dodge City," said Rangel-Lopez, who lives in Dodge City. "They were in the parking lot and trying to pick up people." National Beef said it was committed to supporting employees and following the law. "We are providing legally appropriate cooperation and attempting to work through this process with the Department of Homeland Security in an orderly way," spokesperson Toby Cook said. He declined to answer specific questions about ICE activity. Cargill did not respond to a request for comment. Few employees showed up to the National Beef plant in Liberal on Thursday because ICE agents were targeting all people of color, said Janeth Vazquez, the city's vice mayor. ICE agents also circled an elementary school that has students with undocumented parents, and many children did not show up for class, she said. "Our community is a ghost town," Vazquez said. "Businesses are not open because people are scared to leave their homes."

item.title: BNDES aprova R$329 mi para Rio de Janeiro eletrificar frota de ônibus
item.description: O Banco Nacional de Desenvolvimento Econômico e Social (BNDES) aprovou financiamento de R$329 milhões para a cidade do Rio de Janeiro desenvolver um projeto de eletrificação de sua frota de ônibus por meio de uma Parceria Público-Privada (PPP), afirmou a instituição de fomento nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Banco Nacional de Desenvolvimento Econômico e Social (BNDES) aprovou financiamento de R$329 milhões para a cidade do Rio de Janeiro desenvolver um projeto de eletrificação de sua frota de ônibus por meio de uma Parceria Público-Privada (PPP), afirmou a instituição de fomento nesta sexta-feira. Os recursos são provenientes do Fundo Clima, afirmou o banco. A publicação do edital da PPP está prevista para novembro. A iniciativa é considerada um projeto piloto e está alinhada ao plano municipal de alcançar 20% da frota de ônibus com veículos de emissão zero até 2030, equivalente a aproximadamente mil ônibus, segundo o BNDES. A PPP está sendo estruturada na modalidade concessão administrativa, com duração de 16 anos. O projeto prevê a aquisição e operação de 175 ônibus elétricos e sua infraestrutura de recarga. Uma garagem pública para os veículos está prevista nos planos. A aquisição dos 175 ônibus elétricos representa um primeiro lote que deverá receber um investimento de R$509 milhões, dos quais R$329 milhões a serem financiados pelo BNDES. "Estamos falando de um projeto que dá início à eletrificação da frota da cidade", disse o secretário municipal de transportes do Rio de Janeiro, Jorge Arraes.

item.title: Nigeria's Amni, TotalEnergies approve $800 million offshore gas project
item.description: Nigeria's state oil firm NNPC Ltd said on Friday that a proposed $800 million offshore natural gas project by local producer Amni International and TotalEnergies had reached a final investment decision, marking one of the biggest recent investments in Nigeria's upstream gas sector.
item.dc:creator: Tife Owolabi
item.content:encoded: Nigeria's state oil firm NNPC Ltd said on Friday that a proposed $800 million offshore natural gas project by local producer Amni International and TotalEnergies had reached a final investment decision, marking one of the biggest recent investments in Nigeria's upstream gas sector. The Ima gas project located on Oil Mining Leases 112 and 117 is expected to produce around 300 million standard cubic feet of gas per day at peak output. Gas from the project will feed Nigeria LNG's Train 7 expansion, boosting the Bonny Island plant's production capacity to 30 million tonnes per year from 22 million. NNPC said the investment was enabled by President Bola Tinubu's [USN:L8N4481U5 TEXT:"oil reforms"], which introduced fiscal incentives for gas projects, streamlined contracting processes and lowered development costs. According to NNPC, which grants approvals for such projects, the Ima project is the fourth major gas development to reach FID since Tinubu's 2024 oil reforms.

item.title: Trump’s diplomatic blitz may offer little election relief
item.description: US President Donald Trump is wrapping up a busy week meeting with foreign leaders. Did it do him any good? Welcome to a special Friday edition of the newsletter as we talk about the United Nations General Assembly and Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to the White House.
item.dc:creator: Trevor Hunnicutt
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump is wrapping up a busy week meeting with foreign leaders. Did it do him any good? Welcome to a special Friday edition of the newsletter as we talk about the United Nations General Assembly and Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to the White House. When Trump raised a glass in Xi’s honor at Thursday’s state dinner, he did so with sparkling wine from the same California vintner that supplied the historic toast between US President Richard Nixon and Chinese Premier Zhou Enlai in Beijing in 1972. The symbolic gesture was a tribute to what many scholars regard as one of Washington’s finest diplomatic coups of modern times, the establishment of relations with the People's Republic of China. Nixon was riding high then; two years later, the Republican’s political career was over. Political fortunes can change fast. Trump spent the first year of his second term in office riding high politically as voters largely rallied behind a series of aggressive foreign policy moves, culminating in the audacious capture of Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro. Year two has been different. The war in Iran has driven up fuel prices and become a growing political liability for Republicans ahead of the November midterm elections. This week, Trump’s approval rating sank to 32%, the [USN:L6N45D0NV TEXT:"lowest of his political career"], according to a [USN:L6N43U101 TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos poll."] The Xi dinner capped a big foreign policy week for Trump that also included meetings in New York for the United Nations General Assembly. It is not clear that either event may do much for him come Election Day as pollsters say Americans are squarely focused on the cost of living, not foreign policy. There was little movement on the one pressing foreign policy issue – the US war with Iran, which is causing costs at home to rise. Two Republicans in tight US Senate races called on Monday for a [USN:L1N45D0Y8 TEXT:"swift end"] to the war, and the Senate itself on Thursday narrowly rejected [USN:L1N45F10L TEXT:"a resolution"] calling for the same. Trump told Americans he does not expect the war he started with Israel in February to end by Election Day. “I believe we'll make a deal right after the election because it doesn't make sense for them not to,” Trump told [USN:L1N45D0Z2 TEXT:"the UN"] on Tuesday, speaking about Iran. “They're waiting to see how I do in the midterm election.” Iran’s president said the country [USN:L1N45F09P TEXT:"“will not bow to pressure.”"] Trump is also seeking quick solutions to curb record fuel prices. On Tuesday, he [USN:SPN45A01C TEXT:"backed a ban on diesel exports"], only to have his energy secretary, Chris Wright, [USN:L6N45F0QA TEXT:"dismiss the idea"] the next day as a step that could raise gasoline and jet fuel prices. While Xi's visit to Washington delivered no obvious breakthroughs, it did buy Trump time by extending a market-stabilizing trade truce due to expire in November into the new year. The week's diplomacy also produced no major setbacks, sparing Republicans from new shocks that could pose fresh electoral challenges. Republicans are hoping the political winds will shift in their favor. But with just 39 days until elections, time may be running out for Trump to convince voters he is just as focused on easing their economic anxieties as managing crises abroad. TOP US POLITICS HEADLINES [USN:L6N45F0ZI TEXT:"Exclusive - Hacked FBI data has sensitive information about employees’ intelligence roles"] [USN:L6N43Z058 TEXT:"How US states mistakenly added 30,000 non-citizens to voter rolls"] [USN:L6N44B0W4 TEXT:"Republicans may have gerrymandered their way into a Texas-sized Latino problem"] [USN:L6N45F193 TEXT:"Rush of money, campaign stops show Republicans feel vulnerable in Iowa, Kansas"] [USN:L1N44V0ZM TEXT:"Trump's favorite 2026 campaign target is Biden - nearly 900 mentions and counting"] [USN:L1N45D0TS TEXT:"As resistance mounts, Trump reaches for a familiar shield: national security"] POLL OF THE WEEK YOUR QUESTION ABOUT THE BIGGEST ISSUES INFLUENCING THE MOST COMPETITIVE RACES OF THE NOVEMBER MIDTERMS Which national issues—including healthcare and medical research, climate and environmental policy, and foreign policy toward Iran—are having the greatest influence on competitive races, and how are candidates connecting those issues to voters’ daily lives? Answer by Nathan Layne and Jason Lange Our Reuters/Ipsos polling suggests that rising prices, exacerbated by the war with Iran, are having an outsized impact on the midterm environment. About half of voters say the cost of living is the single most important issue in the congressional elections, compared with roughly one in five who cite democratic norms and about one in 10 who point to immigration. That focus on inflation extends across the major expenses that dominate household budgets, from housing and healthcare to food and fuel. Gasoline prices, pushed higher by the conflict, and the elevated cost of grocery staples such as coffee and beef are particularly potent politically because voters encounter them regularly at the pump and checkout counter. Starting this past summer, our polling has shown that, for the first time in a decade, voters view Democrats as better stewards of the economy than Republicans. Against that backdrop, Republican strategists and party officials say they are seeking to frame the midterms as a choice between two parties, casting Democrats as increasingly influenced by socialist ideas, rather than a referendum on current economic conditions. THE VIEW FROM GREENLAND My Reuters colleagues traveled to the [USN:L6N45F0P1 TEXT:"desolate Arctic outpost"] of Mestersvig, which sits 149 miles from the nearest settlement, that will soon be home to American troops as part of a new defense agreement struck between Trump and the leaders of Greenland and Denmark this week. The US soldiers should be prepared to bundle up, according to Anders Ibsen, a former officer with Denmark's Sirius dog sled patrol, an elite unit that uses Mestersvig to resupply. "This is as remote, as cold, and as extreme as you can find in the world. You have to go to Antarctica to find similar conditions," he told Reuters. Currently, only three soldiers maintain the facility, which was built in the 1960s and includes barracks to house 150 soldiers. WHAT TO WATCH FOR September 26: Trump attends Tennessee-Texas college football game in Knoxville September 27: Trump expected to attend Presidents Cup in Illinois October 5: Supreme Court term opens THE WHO, WHAT AND WHEN [USN:L1N45G0ZE TEXT:"Why the court fight over the White House media ban isn't over"] [USN:L6N45E11V TEXT:"US diesel exports ban would hurt global fuel markets, analysts say"] [USN:L6N45G1DV TEXT:"Who was on the Trump-Xi state dinner guest list?"]

item.title: ウクライナ和平案「全て選択肢」、ロシアの国益見極めへ＝プーチン氏
item.description: [モスクワ ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ　２５日　ロイター] - ロシアのプーチン大統領は２５日、ロシアが全面侵攻するウクライナとの和平について、和平案の全ての選択肢が残っていると述べると同時に、ロシアにとって何が最善になるか見極める必要があるとの考えを示した。

プーチン氏は国内報道各社に対し、ロシアは１８─２０日に実施された下院選後にウクライナとの交渉を再開する用意があったものの、ウクライナがロシアの投票所などへの攻撃を行ったと主張。挑発的な攻撃を行ったのはウクライナで、代償としてロシアによる継続的な報復攻撃を受けることになると述べた。

その上で、ウクライナとの和平案は「全てが選択肢として残っている」としながらも、「ウクライナが行ってきたことを踏まえると、どう対応すべきか慎重に考えなければならない」と語った。

item.title: Meta engañó a consumidores en caso de Cambridge Analytica, según un jurado de Nuevo México
item.description: Un jurado de Santa Fe, Nuevo México, dictaminó el viernes que Meta Platforms engañó a los residentes del estado, en un caso derivado de las acusaciones de que la consultora política Cambridge Analytica —que colaboró en la campaña presidencial de Donald Trump en 2016— obtuvo datos de millones de usuarios de Facebook sin su consentimiento.
item.dc:creator: Diana Jones
item.content:encoded: Un jurado de Santa Fe, Nuevo México, dictaminó el viernes que Meta Platforms (META.O) engañó a los residentes del estado, en un caso derivado de las acusaciones de que la consultora política Cambridge Analytica —que colaboró en la campaña presidencial de Donald Trump en 2016— obtuvo datos de millones de usuarios de Facebook sin su consentimiento. El veredicto se conoce tras un juicio de dos semanas por una demanda presentada por el fiscal general de Nuevo México en 2021, tres años después de que noticias revelaron que se habían recopilado datos personales de hasta 87 millones de usuarios de Facebook a través de una aplicación de terceros y se habían usado para elaborar perfiles de votantes. La demanda acusó a la empresa de realizar declaraciones que inducían a error a los habitantes de Nuevo México sobre cómo se compartiría su información personal con terceros, sobre cómo gestionaba el discurso de odio y la desinformación en la plataforma, y sobre si daba preferencia a algunos usuarios a la hora de aplicar sus políticas. Facebook no informó a los usuarios de que vendía sus datos a terceros y permitió que se difundieran en la plataforma discursos de odio o desinformación cuando ello beneficiaba a los resultados económicos de la empresa, dijeron los abogados del estado. Tras el veredicto, el juez Francis Mathew determinará el importe de las sanciones económicas que Meta deberá pagar por las infracciones constatadas por el jurado. La demanda del estado se centró en declaraciones concretas, incluidos comentarios realizados por el presidente ejecutivo de Meta, Mark Zuckerberg, o en entradas del blog de la empresa, que, según Nuevo México, hacían creer a las personas que tenían control sobre la información personal que compartían en el sitio web, o que este contaba con políticas generales sobre cómo abordaba el discurso de odio o la desinformación. En realidad, Meta vendía los datos a aplicaciones de terceros, como aquella en la que se basaba Cambridge Analytica, y aplicaba excepciones a sus políticas para determinados usuarios, según el Estado. Los abogados de Meta argumentaron durante el juicio que las declaraciones supuestamente engañosas eran fragmentos seleccionados de forma selectiva que ignoraban el contexto fundamental de las mismas declaraciones, en las que la empresa había reconocido repetidamente que su gestión de la desinformación o de las cuestiones de privacidad no era perfecta. La empresa mejora constantemente y no se beneficia de que se comparta contenido perjudicial en su plataforma, dijeron. Meta también negó que vendiera la información de los usuarios. Reuters siguió el juicio a través de Courtroom View Network.

item.title: Imran Khan's party postpones planned Islamabad march to October 4
item.description: Jailed former prime minister Imran Khan's Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf party has postponed a planned long march from Peshawar to Islamabad until October 4, the chief minister of the PTI-ruled Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, Sohail Afridi, told reporters on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Jailed former prime minister Imran Khan's Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf party has postponed a planned long march from Peshawar to Islamabad until October 4, the chief minister of the PTI-ruled Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, Sohail Afridi, told reporters on Friday. PTI had planned to begin the march on September 27 to press for the release of Khan, who has been in jail since 2023. The PTI's last large-scale protest two years ago ended in deadly clashes with security forces. Earlier this week, Pakistan curbed access to its capital, Islamabad, by blocking major highways with shipping containers and deploying tens of thousands of security forces, ahead of the march planned by Khan's supporters. Party spokesperson Zulfi Bukhari, however, told Reuters that although they had moved the planned date to October 4, they could launch the march earlier. "We can now do it whenever we deem fit. The question is to the government, as to how long they're willing to keep the country closed off?", Bukhari said. Authorities have detained three of Khan's sisters and hundreds of party activists in recent days, citing a need to maintain public order. Khan, 73, a former cricket star ousted by parliament in a 2022 no-confidence vote, has claimed to be a political prisoner.

item.title: Russell wary of Antonelli threat despite dominant Baku pole
item.description: George Russell refused to rule out Mercedes teammate Kimi Antonelli as a threat to his victory hopes in Saturday’s Azerbaijan Grand Prix, despite the Briton starting from pole and the championship leader 16th after a costly qualifying crash.
item.dc:creator: Abhishek Takle
item.content:encoded: George Russell refused to rule out Mercedes teammate Kimi Antonelli as a threat to his victory hopes in Saturday’s Azerbaijan Grand Prix, despite the Briton starting from pole and the championship leader 16th after a costly qualifying crash. “Obviously, you can’t discount Kimi,” said Russell after eclipsing Ferrari’s Charles Leclerc, his closest challenger, by 0.837 seconds in Friday’s qualifying. “You know, started 19th in Monza and now he’s in 16th, so, yeah, he should be leading by a few laps early this time,” joked Russell after Antonelli recovered to win his home [USN:L8N44Y056 TEXT:"Italian Grand Prix"] earlier this month. Antonelli, who leads Russell by 81 points in the overall standings after 14 rounds, was sidelined in the opening phase of qualifying after he clobbered the barriers at the first corner and was forced to park up with a broken suspension. The 20-year-old lost crucial track time after being hit by a hydraulics issue on the opening day of practice and has played catch up to Russell ever since. The Briton in contrast has looked the more at ease and dialled-in of the Mercedes pair around the tricky Baku street circuit layout. “I’ve been feeling in a great spot this whole weekend,” said Russell. “You know, as I’ve said recently, I’m just getting more and more on top of this car and what it requires, and it’s just all feeling more intuitive." Antonelli’s mistake provides an opportunity for Russell to put a dent in his championship advantage. The last time he had such a chance was at Monza, when he started on the front row with Antonelli at the back of the grid. He finished second to the Italian then but is determined to convert this time out in Azerbaijan. “I’m feeling good,” said Russell. “I think we’re in a great place to go for the win but, of course, this is Baku and anything can happen ... but whatever happens, I feel confident that we can go for the win.”

item.title: La OMS afirma que el brote de ébola en el Congo se ha extendido a dos nuevas zonas sanitarias
item.description: La Organización Mundial de la Salud informó el viernes que el brote de ébola provocado por el virus Bundibugyo en la República Democrática del Congo se ha extendido a otras dos zonas sanitarias, lo que eleva a 63 el número total de zonas afectadas en siete provincias.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Organización Mundial de la Salud informó el viernes que el brote de ébola provocado por el virus Bundibugyo en la República Democrática del Congo se ha extendido a otras dos zonas sanitarias, lo que eleva a 63 el número total de zonas afectadas en siete provincias. Las zonas recién afectadas son Bulu, en la provincia de Sud-Ubangi, y Dungu, en la provincia de Haut-Uele, que limita con Sudán del Sur.

item.title: Putin diz que todas propostas de paz para Ucrânia estão em discussão, mas que Rússia pesa seus interesses
item.description: O presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que todas as propostas para um acordo na Ucrânia continuavam em aberto, mas que Moscou ainda precisava avaliar o que era do seu melhor interesse, segundo informaram agências de notícias russas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que todas as propostas para um acordo na Ucrânia continuavam em aberto, mas que Moscou ainda precisava avaliar o que era do seu melhor interesse, segundo informaram agências de notícias russas. Putin, dirigindo-se a jornalistas russos, também disse que Moscou estava disposta a retomar as negociações com Kiev após as eleições parlamentares russas da semana passada, mas que a Ucrânia havia lançado ataques contra Moscou e atingido seções eleitorais. O presidente russo afirmou que foi a Ucrânia quem lançou ataques provocativos e que agora teria de pagar o preço de uma resposta contundente. “Foram eles que começaram. Em todos os lugares, em todas as frentes. Isso é brincadeira, jogo de criança?”, disse Putin aos repórteres. “Eles devem, portanto, sentir os ataques de retaliação da Rússia e compreender que nenhuma ação provocativa, nenhuma tentativa de agitar a situação para garantir um resultado, vai funcionar. Estão apenas piorando as coisas para si mesmos.” Ele disse que essas ações estão por trás dos apelos da Ucrânia por um cessar-fogo e pela retomada das negociações. “Tudo isso está em discussão. Tudo é possível”, disse ele. “Mas, depois de tudo o que fizeram, ainda teremos que pensar cuidadosamente sobre o que precisamos fazer em resposta.” (Reportagem de Maxim Rodionov)

item.title: Canadian dollar heads for third straight weekly decline on wider yield spreads
item.description: The Canadian dollar was on track for its third straight weekly decline against the US dollar on Friday and its steepest since March, as Canadian bond yields fell further below US rates.
item.dc:creator: Fergal Smith
item.content:encoded: The Canadian dollar was on track for its third straight weekly decline against the US dollar on Friday and its steepest since March, as Canadian bond yields fell further below US rates. The loonie was trading 0.1% lower at 1.4152 per US dollar, or 70.66 US cents, after touching its weakest intraday level since July 14 at 1.4154. For the week, the currency was down 1.2%. The move tracked broad-based strength in the US dollar "and is in our view exclusively USD driven," said Amo Sahota, director at Klarity FX in San Francisco. "Rising US yields and a 150 basis point 2-year yield spread between the US and Canada have made it easy to justify the advance," Sahota said. Canada's 2-year yield fell 6.2 basis points further below the equivalent US rate to a gap of roughly 153 basis points, its widest since February 2025. A lower relative yield tends to reduce the attractiveness of a currency. The [USN:L6N45H0ON TEXT:"US dollar"] fell against a basket of major currencies as oil prices eased, but was poised for a second straight weekly advance as investors raised bets on additional interest rate hikes from the Federal Reserve. New orders for key [USN:L1N45H0BU TEXT:"US-manufactured capital goods"] increased more than expected in August and data for the prior month was revised sharply higher, pointing to another quarter of robust growth in business spending on equipment amid an artificial intelligence infrastructure buildout. Canadian economic data was less upbeat, with a preliminary estimate showing that [USN:S0N3ZU02D TEXT:"wholesale trade"] declined 1.5% in August from July. The price of [USN:L1N45H013 TEXT:"oil"], one of Canada's major exports, fell as markets weighed the possibility of a truce between the US and Iran. US crude oil futures were trading 2.6% lower at $92.17 a barrel. Canadian bond yields eased across a steeper curve, with the 10-year down 4.2 basis points at 3.956%.

item.title: Sparks fire coach Lynne Roberts after missing playoffs
item.description: The Los Angeles Sparks fired head coach Lynne Roberts on Friday after falling short of the playoffs in both of her seasons with the team.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Los Angeles Sparks fired head coach Lynne Roberts on Friday after falling short of the playoffs in both of her seasons with the team. The Sparks concluded a 16-28 season with a 76-75 home loss to the Golden State Valkyries on Thursday night. "We are grateful to Lynne for the commitment and determination she brought to the role, which was evident all the way through our last game last night," Sparks special advisor Farhan Zaidi said. "Lynne has cared deeply about our organization and for our players and their development. We sincerely thank her for everything she has invested in the Sparks and wish her and her family the best moving forward." Roberts, 51, was 37-51 in two seasons with Los Angeles, her first head coaching job in the WNBA. She was a head coach in the collegiate ranks at Utah (2015-24), Pacific (2006-15) and Chico State (2002-06). Roberts was asked about her future with the team prior to Thursday's regular-season finale. "I think we've had two tough years of injuries, and I'm not trying to blame anything on that, it's just the reality," she said, per ESPN. "There has been a lot of change. Our president's been here ... four months. So just again, so much change." The Sparks moved on from guard Kelsey Plum with a trade deadline deal to the Phoenix Mercury on Aug. 2 after she missed 12 games with a lingering lower leg injury. Plum played her last game with the Sparks on June 21 and Los Angeles had an 8-20 record through the remainder of the season. Roberts inherited a team that finished 8-32 under predecessor Curt Miller in 2024. The Sparks have not made the playoffs since the COVID-shortened 2020 season. --Field Level Media

item.title: GRANOS Los futuros del trigo bajan mientras la atención se centra en la diplomacia del mar Negro
item.description: Los futuros de cereales en la Bolsa de Chicago (CBOT) caían el viernes bajo la presión de los esfuerzos diplomáticos para mitigar las perturbaciones a las exportaciones de cereales del mar Negro causadas por la guerra, dijeron analistas.
item.dc:creator: Tom Polansek
item.content:encoded: Los futuros de cereales en la Bolsa de Chicago (CBOT) caían el viernes bajo la presión de los esfuerzos diplomáticos para mitigar las perturbaciones a las exportaciones de cereales del mar Negro causadas por la guerra, dijeron analistas. La falta de detalles sobre nuevos acuerdos agrícolas durante la cumbre entre Estados Unidos y China también pesó sobre los precios. El contrato de trigo más negociado cayó por debajo del umbral de los 7 dólares por bushel por primera vez en un mes, por las expectativas de una recuperación de los envíos desde el mar Negro, que se han visto gravemente afectados por la guerra de Rusia contra Ucrania. Ha habido "un notable aumento de los esfuerzos de mediación para facilitar el transporte de materias primas a través del mar Negro", señaló Mike Castle, economista sénior especializado en materias primas de la consultora StoneX. "Lo que cabe destacar de este nuevo impulso es que se centra en el transporte marítimo por el mar Negro en sí mismo, y no en convertirlo en parte de un acuerdo de paz más amplio", añadió. El trigo en Chicago bajaba 7,5 centavos, a 6,995 dólares por bushel a las 1650 GMT, tras marcar su precio más bajo desde el 19 de agosto, en 6,835 dólares. Los intentos de Turquía por mediar en una tregua en el mar Negro han creado expectativas de una posible mejora en los flujos de transporte marítimo. El máximo de dos meses alcanzado esta semana por el índice dólar también ha frenado las perspectivas de exportación de cereales estadounidenses, antes de que la moneda retrocediera el viernes. El maíz bajaba 0,5 centavos, a 5,27 dólares el bushel, tras tocar un mínimo de un mes, mientras que la soja del CBOT subía 0,5 centavos, a 13,18 dólares el bushel, repuntando tras pérdidas anteriores. La tan esperada cumbre entre Estados Unidos y China no ha dado lugar, hasta el momento, a nuevos compromisos por parte de China para comprar productos agrícolas estadounidenses. No obstante, se espera que Washington dé a conocer el lunes los detalles sobre el resultado de las negociaciones comerciales con China.

item.title: Western Miners Can Match China’s Speed if African Governments Cut Red Tape, Kobold President Says
item.description: By Maxwell Akalaare Adombila and Olivia Kumwenda-Mtambo The top executive of KoBold Metals said Western miners can match China’s pace in developing critical minerals projects in Africa without compromising compliance standards as long as governments streamline approvals and improve coordination among regulators. California-based KoBold, an …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
By Maxwell Akalaare Adombila and Olivia Kumwenda-Mtambo

The top executive of KoBold Metals said Western miners can match China’s pace in developing critical minerals projects in Africa without compromising compliance standards as long as governments streamline approvals and improve coordination among regulators.

California-based KoBold, an exploration firm backed by U.S. billionaires Jeff Bezos and Bill Gates, argues these steps would let Western investors deploy capital faster and compete more effectively with Chinese rivals for Africa’s critical minerals.

“We reject the assertion that you can’t go fast and do things right. You can do both,” KoBold President Josh Goldman told Reuters on Monday.

Competition for Africa’s critical minerals is intensifying as the U.S., Europe and China race to secure supplies of metals vital for electric vehicles, artificial intelligence and defense technologies.

From the Democratic Republic of Congo to Guinea, Chinese firms have often outpaced Western rivals through rapid execution, navigating bureaucratic processes and backing mines with railways, ports and processing plants.

KoBold is seeking faster exploration approvals in Namibia while expanding lithium and copper exploration in Congo, Goldman said.

“We would like to accelerate our investment (in Namibia) because we like the rocks, the operating environment, the jurisdiction and the people, but we need to be able to go faster,” he said before meeting the country’s ministers of international trade and agriculture in New York on Thursday on the company’s concerns.

Namibia’s Presidency and the ministries of international relations and agriculture did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

KoBold, which has invested about $2 million in Namibia since 2022, holds more than 7,000 square kilometers of exploration licenses there, its largest land position globally by area.

In Congo, KoBold is advancing what Goldman described as the country’s largest lithium exploration program, alongside a major copper exploration campaign near the Zambian border as it searches for a world-class discovery comparable to the Manono deposit.

Goldman said the effort was not being slowed by the long-running dispute surrounding Manono, where Australia’s AVZ Minerals and Chinese interests remain locked in competing claims.

“Finding the next Manono doesn’t depend on what happens with the known deposits,” he said.

China’s Zijin Mining began lithium exports from an adjoining block at Manono in June after building supporting infrastructure, Reuters reported.
item.wire:summarySource: The China-Global South Project source metadata
item.wire:bodySource: The China-Global South Project public article data

item.title: WHO says Congo Ebola outbreak spreads to two new health zones
item.description: The World Health Organization said on Friday that the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to two additional health zones, bringing the total number affected to 63 across seven provinces.
item.dc:creator: Siddhi Mahatole
item.content:encoded: The World Health Organization said on Friday that the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to two additional health zones, bringing the total number affected to 63 across seven provinces. The newly affected zones are Bulu in Sud Ubangi province and Dungu in Haut-Uele province, which borders South Sudan. As of September 23, Congo had reported 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths, according to the WHO. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said conflict and population displacement were making it more difficult for health workers to reach affected communities and trace people who may have been exposed to the virus. "It's very difficult to see Ebola in isolation because even our response in Ebola is affected by the conflict because there is displacement and there is access problem to some areas," Tedros said. He said restricted access could leave contacts untraced, while displacement and crowding increased transmission risks. Tedros said cases were declining overall and that contact tracing, safe burials and community engagement had improved, although transmission remained uneven across affected areas. The lack of approved vaccines and treatments for the Bundibugyo strain was also complicating the response and could make people reluctant to seek care at treatment centers, Tedros said, adding the WHO was working to accelerate clinical trials of vaccines and treatments. Turning to the risk of future global health emergencies, Tedros said countries needed to strengthen pandemic preparedness. "Ebola will not be a pandemic, but there could be a respiratory pathogen that can become a pandemic," he said. "Before that hits, we need to prepare." The World Health Assembly adopted the Pandemic Agreement in May 2025 to strengthen global prevention, preparedness and response to future pandemics. "We continue to see significant mis- and disinformation about the WHO Pandemic Agreement, with false claims. It's a power grab that cedes sovereignty to WHO," Tedros said. "This is completely untrue."

item.title: Converse pauses social media ads, marketing after racism uproar, Bloomberg News reports
item.description: Nike-owned sneaker brand Converse told employees it is pausing all marketing this week after an earlier advertisement sparked outrage for evoking imagery of the Ku Klux Klan and lynching, Bloomberg News reported on Friday, citing a person familiar with the decision.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nike-owned (NKE.N) sneaker brand Converse told employees it is pausing all marketing this week after an earlier advertisement sparked outrage for evoking imagery of the Ku Klux Klan and lynching, Bloomberg News reported on Friday, citing a person familiar with the decision. Reuters could not immediately verify the report. Nike did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Converse pulled the advertisement after facing public backlash last week and [USN:L6N45E020 TEXT:"apologized"], saying "we got this wrong." The ad showed the lower half of a person wearing a white, calf-length skirt-like garment, which critics said resembled a KKK robe. The person was featured holding black sneakers. The images were part of a campaign for Converse's Chuck 70 X sneaker, created in collaboration with Karina, a member of the K-pop group Aespa. The ad also drew scrutiny from US lawmakers. In a statement on Monday, the Congressional Black Caucus said it was "deeply disturbed and disappointed by Converse’s decision to release this advertising campaign," and that it would request a meeting with Nike executives. Converse sales have dropped for 13 consecutive quarters, most recently tumbling 34% on a constant-currency basis in the fourth quarter. Nike, which is set to report first-quarter earnings next week, is still facing [USN:L4N4321KS TEXT:"significant obstacles"] as CEO Elliott Hill tries to turn around the business. Shares have fallen more than 40% this year as investors seek clear signs that Hill's nearly two-year effort to revive growth is gaining traction.

item.title: Putin says all Ukraine peace proposals on table, but Russia must weigh its interests
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Friday that all proposals for a settlement in the 4-1/2-year-old war with Ukraine remained on the table, but Moscow still needed to assess what was in its best interests.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Friday that all proposals for a settlement in the 4-1/2-year-old war with Ukraine remained on the table, but Moscow still needed to assess what was in its best interests. Putin also said Moscow had been ready to resume negotiations with Kyiv after last week's Russian parliamentary elections, but Ukraine launched attacks on Moscow and hit polling stations. Addressing journalists in St Petersburg, Russia's second largest city, Putin said it was Ukraine that had launched provocative attacks and would now have to pay the price of a sustained response. "They are the ones who started it. Everywhere, on every front. Are these playthings, child's play?" Putin said in remarks broadcast on Russian television. "They should therefore be made to feel Russia's retaliatory strikes and understand that no provocative actions, no stirring up the situation to secure a result, will work. They're only making things worse for themselves." Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy has said attacks on Russia were a fair response to strikes on his country's civilians and infrastructure, while calling for direct talks with Russia on resolving the war. Putin said Russia's retaliatory actions were behind Ukraine's calls for a ceasefire and a resumption of talks. "They are all on the table. It's all possible," he said. "But after everything they have done, we will still have to think carefully about what we need to do in response." Russian forces have long been conducting strikes on Ukrainian cities, mostly at night, but in recent weeks have targeted Kyiv and other towns with day-long barrages of drones and missiles. [USN:L1N45H03O TEXT:"Air strikes"] on Friday killed seven people in the capital. Ukraine has for months staged a long string of strikes on Russian targets, focusing on the oil industry and retail outlets, some as far as 3,000 km (1,800 miles) from the Ukrainian border. In his comments, Putin said Ukraine's call for new talks was also prompted by the Kyiv military's difficulty in countering jet-powered drones, which fly at higher altitudes and have proved more difficult to intercept. He said Ukraine had provoked confrontation by launching mass attacks on St Petersburg during an international conference in June and on Moscow last week, on the main day of Russia's parliamentary election. Kyiv's forces, he said, had attacked polling stations, killing one election official and injuring others. Referring to [USN:L1N45H0BK TEXT:"talks"] in Washington this week between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, Putin also said Russia welcomed any "agreement of a positive nature" between Washington and Beijing. He said that his participation in the forthcoming APEC summit in China would depend on events at home in Russia.

item.title: Solidigm, da SK Hynix, avalia IPO que poderia precificar a unidade em até US$ 150 bi, dizem fontes
item.description: A Solidigm, da fabricante de chips SK Hynix, está considerando uma oferta pública inicial de ações (IPO) já no próximo ano, que poderia avaliar sua subsidiária norte-americana em até US$150 bilhões, segundo três pessoas familiarizadas com o assunto.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Solidigm, da fabricante de chips SK Hynix (000660.KS) , está considerando uma oferta pública inicial de ações (IPO) já no próximo ano, que poderia avaliar sua subsidiária norte-americana em até US$150 bilhões, segundo três pessoas familiarizadas com o assunto. A Solidigm realizou reuniões de apresentação esta semana com bancos de investimento que competem por papéis no IPO, em um processo conhecido como "bake-off", disseram uma das fontes e uma quarta pessoa, marcando um passo concreto rumo ao que pode se tornar a maior listagem de chips da história dos Estados Unidos. A empresa poderá levantar US$15 bilhões no IPO, disseram as três pessoas, falando sob condição de anonimato para discutir assuntos confidenciais. Os planos, incluindo o tamanho do negócio e o cronograma, ainda estão em fase inicial e podem mudar dependendo das condições de mercado, acrescentaram. A oferta seria um dos maiores IPOs de chips já registrados e poderia fornecer uma avaliação independente para um negócio que se tornou parte fundamental do portfólio de armazenamento da SK Hynix. Além disso, buscaria aproveitar a forte demanda dos investidores por empresas ligadas à infraestrutura de inteligência artificial, que impulsionou os ganhos das ações de chips e hardware. A Solidigm, com sede em Rancho Cordova, Califórnia, é a subsidiária norte-americana da SK Hynix., da Coreia do Sul, especializada em memória flash NAND e unidades de estado sólido (SSDs). A Solidigm recusou-se a comentar. A SK Hynix não respondeu imediatamente ao pedido de comentário. AUMENTANDO A COMPETITIVIDADE A SK Hynix adquiriu o negócio de memória NAND e SSDs da Intel Corp. (INTC.O) por cerca de US$9 bilhões em um acordo anunciado em 2020, combinando essas operações com a Solidigm, que foi lançada como uma subsidiária independente em 2021. Na época, a empresa afirmou que a aquisição fortaleceria seus negócios de memória flash NAND e SSDs corporativos, além de expandir sua posição no mercado global de memórias. A Solidigm fornece SSDs corporativos usados em servidores, infraestrutura de nuvem e data centers. A empresa busca se diferenciar por meio de produtos de armazenamento de alta capacidade projetados para aplicações de IA, onde o crescente volume de dados exige soluções de armazenamento cada vez mais sofisticadas. A Reuters noticiou no início deste mês que a Solidigm está considerando construir uma fábrica de chips de memória flash NAND nos EUA, com o norte do estado de Nova York surgindo como um dos principais candidatos, como parte dos esforços para expandir sua capacidade de produção. No mês passado, a SK Hynix afirmou que estava considerando medidas para impulsionar a competitividade da Solidigm, após notícias na mídia de que a unidade estava explorando uma rodada de captação de recursos pré-IPO de cerca de 5 trilhões de won. Uma avaliação de até US$150 bilhões superaria em muito os IPOs recentes de chips, incluindo a avaliação de aproximadamente US$54 bilhões da Arm Holdings (O9Ty.F) em sua estreia em 2023, e a avaliação totalmente diluída de aproximadamente US$56 bilhões da Cerebras Systems (CBRS.O) em seu IPO de 2026. (Por Milana Vinn e Echo Wang)

item.title: Atlântico Sul ganha protagonismo entre petroleiras globais em meio a incertezas geopolíticas
item.description: A abertura de novas fronteiras exploratórias e a perspectiva de consolidação do Atlântico Sul como uma das principais regiões de crescimento da oferta global de petróleo dominaram os debates da principal conferência do setor na América Latina nesta semana, atraindo executivos das maiores petroleiras do mundo ao Rio de Janeiro em busca de oportunidades, em um momento de crescente preocupação com a segurança energética global.
item.dc:creator: Marta Nogueira
item.content:encoded: A abertura de novas fronteiras exploratórias e a perspectiva de consolidação do Atlântico Sul como uma das principais regiões de crescimento da oferta global de petróleo dominaram os debates da principal conferência do setor na América Latina nesta semana, atraindo executivos das maiores petroleiras do mundo ao Rio de Janeiro em busca de oportunidades, em um momento de crescente preocupação com a segurança energética global. A ROG.e reuniu público recorde de 83 mil pessoas, crescimento de 10% ante a edição anterior, há dois anos, e representantes de 77 países, um aumento de 29%, com discussões centradas no potencial exploratório de países como Brasil, Guiana, Suriname e outros na costa africana, vistos pela indústria como uma alternativa de crescimento em meio a instabilidades geopolíticas em regiões como o Golfo Pérsico. Executivos de companhias como ExxonMobil, BP, Chevron, Shell e TotalEnergies apresentaram um interesse renovado em expandir na região, enquanto autoridades e empresários defenderam que o Atlântico Sul pode assumir um papel cada vez mais estratégico para o abastecimento global de energia. O presidente do Instituto Brasileiro do Petróleo (IBP), Roberto Ardenghy, afirmou que a combinação entre reservas ainda pouco exploradas, estabilidade geopolítica e crescente demanda energética global tem ampliado o interesse internacional pela região. "Não digo que a gente vá substituir o Oriente Médio, acho que não chegaríamos a tanto, mas eu acho que é uma boa alternativa hoje para atender o mundo com essa situação geopolítica tão complicada", disse Ardenghy à Reuters. O surgimento de um novo polo petrolífero formado por Brasil, Guiana e Suriname foi citado nos corredores do evento, num momento em que conflitos no Oriente Médio e a guerra entre Rússia e Ucrânia continuam influenciando decisões de investimento e estratégias de abastecimento. O vice-presidente executivo de Upstream da BP, Gordon Birrell, afirmou que a companhia [USN:L6N45D0VE TEXT:"pretende construir"] no Brasil um polo relevante de produção de petróleo e gás. Já o vice-presidente sênior de Águas Profundas da ExxonMobil, Hunter Farris, disse que a empresa pretende fazer parte do [USN:L6N45E0XH TEXT:"novo capítulo"] da indústria petrolífera no país. A ExxonMobil, com uma presença ainda tímida no Brasil, adquiriu dez blocos em parceria com a Petrobras na Bacia da Foz do Amazonas. A BP, por sua vez, anunciou recentemente sua maior descoberta em anos no Sul da Bacia de Santos, em uma área que fica mais distante dos grandes campos produtores do pré-sal. Já o novo presidente da Shell Brasil (SHEL.L) , João Rosa, reforçou o interesse em continuar expandindo sua atuação no país, onde é a segunda maior produtora após a Petrobras. A empresa estuda um novo poço exploratório em Santos no ano que vem e participa de um outro em execução na região operado pela BP. MUDANÇA DE TOM O foco sobre novas fronteiras exploratórias e segurança energética também evidenciou uma mudança no discurso predominante do setor, devolvendo protagonismo a uma indústria que, até recentemente, se via obrigada a defender seu papel em um mundo que prometia consumir menos combustíveis fósseis. Há apenas alguns anos, discussões sobre transição energética e redução de emissões ocupavam posição central nos grandes encontros da indústria, que buscava enfatizar seu papel no financiamento da descarbonização. Desta vez, executivos concentraram suas mensagens na necessidade de ampliar a oferta de energia e garantir abastecimento em um mundo marcado por conflitos e crescente fragmentação geopolítica. "Uma coisa que para nós era óbvia, para muitas pessoas não era, mas agora ficou evidente: a gente está mostrando a essencialidade do petróleo", disse Ardenghy. Para Décio Oddone, ex-diretor-geral da ANP, a combinação entre aumento da produção brasileira, retomada da exploração em novas fronteiras e busca por fornecedores menos expostos a riscos geopolíticos melhorou as perspectivas para a indústria na região. "Quer trocar o óleo e gás por outra coisa? Vamos trocar, ninguém aqui é negacionista, mas tem que fazer isso dentro de uma lógica que permita às pessoas continuarem andando de ônibus", disse o ex-diretor de Exploração e Produção da Petrobras José Miranda Formigli. "Não adianta você querer desafiar as coisas, porque essa racionalidade econômica vai acabar imperando."

item.title: Meta bolsters Muse safety warning after security vulnerability found, The Information reports
item.description: Meta Platforms is adding a clearer safety warning within Muse after a security researcher discovered a vulnerability in the AI agent that could let an attacker access a user's sensitive personal information, the Information reported on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Meta Platforms (META.O) is adding a clearer safety warning within Muse after a security researcher discovered a vulnerability in the AI agent that could let an attacker access a user's sensitive personal information, the Information reported on Friday. The flaw, reported by an outside researcher through Meta's bug bounty program and not previously disclosed, could have allowed an attacker to access a user's dedicated virtual machine — an individualized cloud-based account containing data including emails and files, according to an internal Meta incident report reviewed by The Information. The vulnerability was initially classified as a "SEV-2," Meta's third-highest severity level on a five-point scale, typically used for incidents with significant impact, the report said. Meta did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Muse, [USN:L6N45010V TEXT:"launched earlier this month"], is Meta's personal AI agent designed to carry out tasks such as shopping, travel booking, emailing and payments on behalf of users. [USN:L4N45F13Q TEXT:"Muse"] has rapidly climbed Apple's App Store and Google Play rankings in recent weeks, topping the free-app charts in the United States and Canada, with market intelligence firm Sensor Tower estimating about 2.8 million downloads in its first two weeks.

item.title: Trump says Treasury's Bessent will not be his AI czar
item.description: Scott Bessent will not be Donald Trump's AI czar, the Republican president said on Friday, adding that he wants his US Treasury secretary to remain in his current role.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Scott Bessent will not be Donald Trump's [USN:L6N45B05O TEXT:"AI czar"], the Republican president said on Friday, adding that he wants his US Treasury secretary to remain in his current role. "Scott Bessent will not be going to be Super Intelligence (SI) Czar. Number One, he doesn’t want to. Number Two, he’s doing such a great job at Treasury, and that’s where I want to keep him! Why would I ever make such a change?" Trump said in a social media post, using his preferred term for artificial intelligence. Last week, Trump said he plans to appoint an artificial intelligence adviser, known as an "AI czar," and create an "AI force," though he gave no details about either initiative or how they would be implemented. Some had seen Bessent [USN:FWN45E0XV TEXT:"as a front runner"] for the role. Last Sunday, he had led talks heavily focused on AI with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng in New York, ahead of this week's summit between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington. Bessent told reporters after the talks that the US side had proposed an AI safety notification mechanism and bilateral dialogue on the issue, with a particular emphasis on national security concerns. The White House did not immediately provide details on who might be tapped for its AI czar. Trump has repeatedly downplayed concerns about AI and argued that additional regulation is unnecessary even as [USN:L6N4520JA TEXT:"fears grow among lawmakers"] in Washington and globally about risks posed by the technology. Top AI researchers have warned that people building AI believe it could kill humans within a decade, following cases of AI agents going rogue to hack external systems. Several Democratic and Republican lawmakers have responded with alarm and calls for more action.

item.title: トランプ氏、ベセント財務長官のＡＩ責任者起用を否定
item.description: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　２５日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２５日、人工知能（ＡＩ）分野を担当する新組織「ＡＩフォース」の責任者にベセント財務長官を起用しない方針を示した。

トランプ氏は「ベセント氏がスーパーインテリジェンス（ＳＩ）ツァーに就任することはない。本人もそれを望んでおらず、財務省で素晴らしい仕事をしている。その職にとどまってほしい」と自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に投稿した。

トランプ氏は１９日、「ＡＩフォース」を創設し、米政府のＡＩ政策を統括する「ＡＩツァー（ＡＩ皇帝）」を任命すると表明。ホワイトハウスは政府のＡＩ政策責任者に誰が起用される可能性があるか、現時点で明らかにしていない。

item.title: Perplexity é processada por startup por supostamente roubar tecnologia de "palavra de ativação"
item.description: A startup DaVoice processou a Perplexity AI em um tribunal federal da Califórnia, nos Estados Unidos, por supostamente roubar segredos comerciais relacionados à tecnologia de "palavra de ativação" para assistentes de IA.
item.dc:creator: Blake Brittain
item.content:encoded: A startup DaVoice processou a Perplexity AI em um tribunal federal da Califórnia, nos Estados Unidos, por supostamente roubar segredos comerciais relacionados à tecnologia de "palavra de ativação" para assistentes de IA. A denúncia, amplamente censurada e apresentada na quinta-feira, afirma que a Perplexity roubou segredos da DaVoice após as empresas colaborarem em uma tecnologia não especificada, "construída com o código-fonte proprietário da DaVoice, lógica de inferência, arquitetura de rede, abordagens de treinamento, dados de treinamento e know-how". Os porta-vozes das empresas não responderam imediatamente aos pedidos de comentários na sexta-feira. A DaVoice é especializada em tecnologia que permite que dispositivos ouçam continuamente "palavras de ativação" para serem ativados. A startup afirmou ter colaborado com empresas como a Volkswagen e a Samsara, empresa de internet das coisas. A Perplexity é mais conhecida por sua tecnologia de mecanismo de busca com inteligência artificial e pelo navegador e assistente de IA Comet.

item.title: Corporate debt maturities set to test US borrowers as rates rise
item.description: A growing wall of US corporate debt is set to mature from 2027, putting pressure on companies to refinance borrowings raised at ultra-low interest rates during the pandemic.
item.dc:creator: Patturaja Murugaboopathy
item.content:encoded: A growing wall of US corporate debt is set to mature from 2027, putting pressure on companies to refinance borrowings raised at ultra-low interest rates during the pandemic. About $4.3 trillion of non-financial corporate bonds issued in US markets will mature between 2027 and 2031, a Reuters analysis of LSEG data showed. Annual maturities rise from about $572 billion in 2027 to roughly $1.03 trillion in 2030, after many companies pushed debt into later years through refinancing. The challenge comes as global debt has climbed above a record $365 trillion, according to the Institute of International Finance, while higher Treasury yields have lifted refinancing costs across markets. The benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield is above 5%, around its highest level since 2007. As the debt comes due, companies that locked in cheap fixed-rate funding earlier in the decade will increasingly have to refinance at higher costs, pressuring earnings and cash flow. The burden will be heaviest for lower-rated borrowers. High-yield bond maturities jump from about $68.5 billion in 2027 to $314.1 billion in 2029, according to LSEG, while investment-grade maturities increase to $512.6 billion from $437 billion. High-yield debt will account for about a third of all maturities in 2029, up from 12% in 2027. Bond fund manager PIMCO said most investment-grade and high-yield issuers should be able to absorb higher refinancing costs, but the weakest borrowers face a sharper squeeze. Coupons on CCC-rated bonds due in 2027 and 2028 could roughly double if refinanced at current index yields, it said. The refinancing wave will coincide with heavy borrowing by major technology companies to fund artificial intelligence infrastructure. Goldman Sachs expects gross debt issuance by hyperscalers including Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft and Oracle to reach $420 billion in 2027, up 60% from estimated 2026 levels.

item.title: ロシアでの拘束、周到な「おとり捜査」 米ＷＳＪ記者が著書で見解
item.description:
Mark Trevelyan
[ロンドン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Mark Trevelyan

[ロンドン　２５日　ロイター] - ２０２３年にロシアで拘束後、スパイ罪に問われ収監されていた米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）のエバン・ゲルシコビッチ記者が、一連の経緯を詳細に記した著書で、自身の拘束がロシア連邦保安庁（ＦＳＢ）による周到な「おとり捜査」によるものだったとの見解を示した。ＷＳＪが２５日、著書の抜粋を報じた。

ゲルシコビッチ記者は、ロシアの軍需生産を巡り、防衛産業の拠点エカテリンブルクの工場の労働組合関係者に２回、対面で取材した。２度目にレストランで会った際、戦車の生産に関するものだとする手書きの書類を見せられ、メモを取っていると、近づいてきた覆面の男らに拘束されたという。

ゲルシコビッチ記者や編集者らは事前に取材のリスクを検討。情報提供者が書類を持ち込まないようにすることや、持ち込まれた場合にも受け取らないことを決めていた。ただ、２回目の対面取材では「書類が手に押し付けられた」とし、これらの２回の対面取材は、ＦＳＢがロシアのプーチン大統領に対し、スパイだと説得し、拘束する承認を得るためだったとの見方を示した。

プーチン氏は２４年２月、米テレビのインタビューで、ゲルシコビッチ記者が機密情報を収集している最中に現行犯逮捕されたとの認識を示していた。

ゲルシコビッチ記者は懲役１６年の判決を受けたが、２４年８月の囚人交換で釈放された。記者やＷＳＪ、米政府は、いずれも記者がスパイだったことを否定している。

item.title: LeBron James: Getting Joel Embiid 'over the hump' factor in joining Sixers
item.description: LeBron James cited a pair of reasons on Friday as to why he signed with the Philadelphia 76ers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: LeBron James cited a pair of reasons on Friday as to why he signed with the Philadelphia 76ers. Speaking on his "Mind the Game" podcast with co-host Steve Nash, James detailed his long-time friendship with fellow Klutch Sports Group client Tyrese Maxey and his desire to guide former MVP Joel Embiid to his first NBA title as factors in him heading to the City of Brotherly Love. James, 41, admitted that Philadelphia's acquisition of former NBA Finals MVP Jaylen Brown got his attention. From there, Maxey got in the ear of "The King" to let him know that the 76ers were on the rise. "When I became a free agent and we decided to let the Lakers know that I wouldn't be returning, he was one of the first people that was on my line, calling me," James said of Maxey. From there, James toyed with the notion of helping Embiid overcome the constant hurdle that has been the second round of the playoffs. "And one of the most important (reasons), to be honest, is the big fella (Embiid), and the only thing he has not done and that's win a championship. And I want to try to help him get that first one," James said of Embiid, who has two scoring titles to go along with his 2023 NBA MVP award. "He has a city on his back. He's been 'The Process' for 10 years, 12 years, however long he's been there. But I think it's time we even get you deeper into The Process. And I hope that I can be, kind of, that final little piece that can help him get over the hump." Signed to a two-year, $8 million contract, James remains one of the league's best players despite his age. He is coming off a season in which he averaged 20.9 points, 7.2 assists and 6.1 rebounds over 60 games. Over his 23 seasons, the 22-time All-Star has averaged 26.8 points, 7.5 rebounds and 7.4 assists in 1,622 games. James is a four-time NBA Finals MVP, a 21-time All-NBA selection, a three-time All-Star Game MVP and a member of the NBA's 75th anniversary team. He also is the first player to earn NBA Finals MVP honors with three teams: Los Angeles Lakers, Miami Heat, Cleveland Cavaliers. Drafted No. 1 overall by the Cavaliers in 2003, James played seven seasons before taking his talents to South Beach with the Heat, winning his first two NBA titles in Miami. He went back home to Cleveland and helped end a 56-year title drought in 2016. In 2018, he joined the Lakers and led them to a championship in 2020. --Field Level Media
